question: Should this PR be considered merge-ready before exact-current-head live Slack proof is added?
rationale: The code and automated coverage support the design, but the only real Slack evidence comes from a different implementation lineage predating substantial delivery-path rewrites.

options.title: Require exact-head proof
options.body: Keep the PR open and require a redacted live Slack transcript or recording from the current head before merge.

options.title: Accept historical proof
options.body: Treat the earlier live run and current automated coverage as sufficient despite the later port.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open and require a redacted live Slack transcript or recording from the current head before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects Vincent Koc most directly to the rewritten Slack delivery paths whose exact-head behavior remains unproven.
